title: Buaflow change proposal v1
description: One change to a project's AI configuration (AGENTS.md, rules, skills, hooks, settings, stack.json), from the evidence that motivated it to the eval runs that decide whether it stays (EV-006). Phase 8 already said a lesson should move up from a note to a rule to a hook as it recurs; this records each move with what it was supposed to fix and whether it did, so a change that fixed nothing can be seen and rolled back instead of accumulating.

evidence.description: What happened that motivated the change: failure records, eval runs, trial findings, incidents. Repository-relative files, checked for existence.

expect.description: The eval cases whose outcome this change is supposed to decide. A change nobody can name a case for is a change nobody can evaluate.

before.description: Eval run files from before the change.

after.description: Eval run files from after the change, judging the current case revisions.
